description: Build a transfer summary (sender, recipient, amount, gas). Does not broadcast. Solana native: returns key_info only — after the user confirms, call dex_tx_get_sol_unsigned and sign that result immediately. Do not sign a Solana transaction built before confirmation. EVM: returns unsigned_tx_hex and txBundle. → swap_quote/swap_prepare for token exchange.

amount.description: Amount in token units. Precision depends on token/decimals. Examples: '1', '0.5', '0.000001'

chain.description: Chain name or alias (default ETH). Resolved to canonical name from chain config; downstream sign/broadcast should use the same logical chain.

max_fee_per_gas.description: EVM only: override max fee per gas (wei). Use when replacing a pending tx: set ≥1.1× the previous max_fee_per_gas to fix replacement transaction underpriced.

max_priority_fee_per_gas.description: EVM only: override max priority fee per gas (wei). When replacing, set ≥1.1× previous max_priority_fee_per_gas.

mcp_token.description: MCP session token obtained from login (dex_auth_google_login_poll or dex_auth_gate_login_poll). MUST be provided in every call to this tool after login; omitting it will result in 403

nonce.description: Transaction nonce. Omit to use current chain nonce (eth_getTransactionCount), ensuring tx can be mined and found on explorer; wrong nonce causes tx to fail or not appear.

priority_fee_micro_lamports.description: Solana only: optional priority fee (micro-lamports per compute unit). Use 1000-10000 if broadcast returns replacement transaction underpriced.

token.description: Token symbol for display (default USDT). Use ETH/NATIVE for native; USDT for USDT; or use token_contract/token_mint for any token.

token_contract.description: EVM: ERC20 contract address for arbitrary token. When set, token_decimals is used (default 18). Solana: unused.

token_decimals.description: Token decimals (e.g. 6, 18). Required when using token_contract (EVM) or token_mint (Solana); default 18 for ERC20, 9 for SOL.

token_mint.description: Solana: SPL token mint address for SPL transfer. When set, token_decimals is required. EVM: unused.

name: dex_tx_transfer_preview
